versions.content: RteBswEventToTaskMapping must not reference OsTask if RteBswEventIsMappedToTask!=TRUE Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00018 If RteBswEventToTaskMapping . RteBswEventIsMappedToTask is not set to TRUE , RteBswMappedToTaskRef of this RteBswEventToTaskMapping shall not reference an OsTask .
